title: 7 Signs a Godly Man Is the Same Guy in Every Room
caption:
No church version. No screen version.

A godly man's group chat language matches his Sunday language. His search history wouldn't change a single conversation this week. He'd let any of his brothers read his last ten texts, because there's nothing in his pocket he's building a defense for.

"Let your yes be yes and your no be no." Matthew 5:37

What he posts and what he lives aren't two separate men.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #integrity #authenticity
